caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware crock with a lid. The crock is a light tan color with subtle brown and beige shading, giving it a textured appearance. It has two small, rounded handles on either side near the top. The lid fits snugly on top and is colored in various shades of brown, with a circular raised knob in the center. On the front of the crock, there is a decorative blue design that appears to be hand-painted, featuring symmetrical, abstract, leafy shapes with a central vertical element and flourishes extending outward. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Crock with Cover
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
